boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Hawk Hill spaces for studying, meeting, reflection, recreation and campus life, supported by Saint Joseph’s University sources.

cards.title: Francis A. Drexel Library
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · research, writing and study
cards.notes: Bring a research question or writing task, then use the library’s study setting and ask staff for help locating credible sources.
cards.short_summary: A campus library space for research support, writing and quiet academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s identifies Drexel Library as a place to research, write and study, with librarian appointments and an environment for quiet study and thoughtful exchange.
cards.source_title: Library & Learning Commons | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Located on Hawk Hill; consult the library’s hours and events page before visiting.

cards.title: Post Learning Commons Atrium
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · library meeting and event space
cards.notes: Use one of the atrium’s reservable corner areas when your group needs a campus setting for a planned meeting or event.
cards.short_summary: A reservable atrium area within the library and learning commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library & Learning Commons lists three Post Learning Commons Atrium corner areas among spaces students may reserve.
cards.source_title: Library & Learning Commons | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Student reservations are available; use the university’s room-reservation process.

cards.title: Post Learning Commons Lounges
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · reservable group spaces
cards.notes: For a group session, reserve a lounge sized for your meeting instead of relying on an unplanned open table.
cards.short_summary: Library lounges with listed capacities for small-to-medium group use.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s lists Post Learning Commons Lounges, with capacities from eight to 40, as student-reservable meeting and event spaces.
cards.source_title: Library & Learning Commons | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Student reservations are available; capacity varies by lounge.

cards.title: Post Learning Commons Terrace
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · reservable library terrace
cards.notes: Check the reservation process before planning an outdoor group gathering on the terrace, especially when weather matters.
cards.short_summary: A named terrace among the library’s student-reservable spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library & Learning Commons includes the Post Learning Commons Terrace in its list of spaces available for student reservations.
cards.source_title: Library & Learning Commons | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Student reservations are available; confirm availability and weather plans with the library.

cards.title: Drexel Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · project work for groups of two or more
cards.notes: Reserve a room for project work with at least one partner, and use the provided whiteboard supplies for planning together.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group rooms equipped with whiteboards and shared study tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s says library study rooms are for groups of two or more and are equipped with whiteboards, markers and erasers.
cards.access_notes: Students may reserve up to two weeks ahead for a maximum of two hours; visitors may not reserve rooms.

cards.title: Campion Student Center
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · student life and campus services
cards.notes: Use the center as a practical starting point for student-life questions, campus programs, or a planned meeting in its listed rooms.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student center housing Student Life, inclusion services and gathering rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hawk Hill campus map lists Student Life, Inclusion and Diversity, Doyle Banquet Hall, Saxbys and The Pod in Campion Student Center.
cards.source_title: Hawk Hill Campus Map | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Campus map location: building 17 on Hawk Hill. Individual offices and spaces may have separate access rules.

cards.title: Chapel of St. Joseph
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · reflection and worship
cards.notes: When you want a quieter pause, check the chapel’s current programming and choose a reflection or worship opportunity that fits.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel used for reflection programming and university worship.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s describes the Chapel of St. Joseph as a place to stop for reflection during Mission Week and lists it on the Hawk Hill map.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies; check Campus Ministry or university event information before attending a specific service.

cards.title: Frances M. Maguire Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Maguire Campus · free public galleries
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit during public hours, and use the museum’s directions because Lapsley Lane is accessed from City Avenue only.
cards.short_summary: A university art museum with free admission and publicly listed visiting hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that admission is free for all visitors and publishes public hours, directions and accessibility information.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Frances M. Maguire Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Public summer hours are Wednesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closures and hours are posted by the museum.

cards.title: O’Pake Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Maguire Campus · fitness, recreation and lounge space
cards.notes: Check recreation access and current facility hours, then choose a workout, fitness-studio session, or lounge stop that suits your day.
cards.short_summary: A renovated recreation center with fitness areas, a studio and student lounge space.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s says the renovated O’Pake center includes modern fitness equipment, a cardio mezzanine, a fitness studio and a student lounge space.
cards.source_title: O’Pake Fitness and Recreation Center Reopens | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Facility access and hours vary; the recreation office directs users to check current hours and membership terms.

cards.title: Lannon Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Hawk Hill · residential study areas
cards.notes: If you live in Lannon, use a study lounge for a change of setting and follow residence-hall access and community expectations.
cards.short_summary: Study lounges within the Lannon Hall residential community.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Joseph’s lists study lounges among Lannon Hall’s amenities and identifies the building as housing 254 residents.
cards.source_title: Lannon Hall | Residence Life | Saint Joseph's University
cards.access_notes: Residential space; access is subject to residence-life policies and building entry requirements.
